scope: Matched training-only loss intervention followed by reused validation; no final corpus or board.
hypothesis: Can bounded pressure on high-confidence negative predictions reduce shared similar-word mistakes without starving ordinary negatives or making positive recall worse?
change: For negative examples only, keep binary cross-entropy and multiply by 1 + gain * stop_gradient(p^2). This does not change the examples, architecture, score cadence or audio.
advance: Use the strict validation selection policy; focus must qualify and beat control macro recall by at least 0.03. If control cannot qualify, require focus to qualify and beat the best control zero-event, <=2% per-group macro recall by 0.03. No promotion from float or failed fallback.
notes: 1000-step continuation screens direction only. Both exports use identical training representative draws. No final or room performance inferred.
